remarks: Back on market - Multiple offers previously received. Inspection complete with no issues and appraisal exceeded list price! A rare second chance for qualified buyers.Welcome to this immaculate, fully renovated home in the highly desirable Newfield neighborhood! This beautifully and elegantly redone residence truly has the wow factor-just move right in and enjoy. Offering 2 bedrooms, 2 additional dens, a sun-filled bonus room or office, a full basement, and a generous .43-acre lot, the layout is both spacious and flexible. Every detail has been thoughtfully upgraded, including a brand new kitchen with high-end Gallery appliances, a stunningly renovated bathroom, new windows, new garage door, brand new floors, recessed lighting, a newer boiler, newer roof, and a hot water heater that's just 2 years old. Whether you're looking to entertain, work from home, or enjoy turnkey living in a fantastic location, this home is not to be missed!
